params.1274: Form a Dungeoneering group (see the Task 'Party On, Dudes!').
params.1275: Click on the door to Daemonheim and choose the level and complexity to raid.
params.1276: Navigate the dungeon using all your skills, and defeat the boss.
params.2225: Increasing your Dungeoneering level opens more floors of Daemonheim and allows access to secret resource dungeons in the rest of RuneScape. Dungeoneering tokens can be traded for powerful items and abilities.
